title: Wasalt platform overview
text: Wasalt is a Saudi Arabian real estate platform that describes itself as the first AI-powered property platform in the Kingdom, covering residential and commercial properties for sale and rent, off-plan Projects and Daily Rentals. It is a joint venture between Dar Al Arkan and Quara Holding, uses AI technology from propgenius.ai, and lists properties verified through REGA (the Real Estate General Authority). It also supports property auctions in partnership with Infath, and offers an app.
